      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility as a flat single-line address; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they take precedence and this value is returned as the composed line ('addressLine1' plus, when present, a single space and 'addressLine2'). An owner is valid when it supplies an address in EITHER form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; must be non-blank when supplied. Stored and returned normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.). Stored and returned normalized when supplied, and appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a 4-digit code that is valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and postcode (they share a household), and marks it as a declared member so it is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.

        - type: object
          properties:

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1

              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

              items:

            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: "/api/owners/1"
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the 'title' followed by a single space and the 'lastName' when a title is present, or just the 'lastName' when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: "DR who"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, else UNKNOWN) and HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: "NSW-1A2B3C4D"
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household, derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same last name and postcode always carry the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: "5f2b3c1a-8d4e-3f6a-9b2c-1d0e7a5f4c33"
              readOnly: true

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number

              type: string
              example: "NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26"
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more (householdSize >= 3); add 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (the fiscal year of the registrationDate is earlier than the current fiscal year, fiscal years starting 1 July). A newly created owner has zero tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality (region), the REGION segment of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city yields a region.
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region yields no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: "STANDARD_METRO"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's business day (a bulk sign-up), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of, set when possibleDuplicate is true, otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted (marked deleted while the record is retained); false for a live owner. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true

            telephoneDisplay:

              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility as a flat single-line address; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they take precedence and this value is returned as the composed line ('addressLine1' plus, when present, a single space and 'addressLine2'). An owner is valid when it supplies an address in EITHER form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; must be non-blank when supplied. Stored and returned normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.). Stored and returned normalized when supplied, and appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a 4-digit code that is valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and postcode (they share a household), and marks it as a declared member so it is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: "/api/owners/1"
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the 'title' followed by a single space and the 'lastName' when a title is present, or just the 'lastName' when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: "DR who"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, else UNKNOWN), FY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate (fiscal year starting 1 July, identified by the calendar year in which it ends), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: "NSW261A2B3C4D7"
              readOnly: true

              title: Household ID

              type: string
              example: "5f2b3c1a-8d4e-3f6a-9b2c-1d0e7a5f4c33"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate (fiscal year starting 1 July, identified by the calendar year in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: "NSW-1A2B3C4D-M26"
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more (householdSize >= 3); add 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (the fiscal year of the registrationDate is earlier than the current fiscal year, fiscal years starting 1 July). A newly created owner has zero tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality (region), the REGION segment of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city yields a region.
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region yields no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: "STANDARD_METRO"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's business day (a bulk sign-up), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of, set when possibleDuplicate is true, otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted (marked deleted while the record is retained); false for a live owner. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:

              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS or DR). When present it is used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility as a flat single-line address; when the structured 'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they take precedence and this value is returned as the composed line ('addressLine1' plus, when present, a single space and 'addressLine2'). An owner is valid when it supplies an address in EITHER form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address (street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address' when present; must be non-blank when supplied. Stored and returned normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address (unit, suite, etc.). Stored and returned normalized when supplied, and appended to 'addressLine1' with a single space to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a 4-digit code that is valid for the owner's city region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on create; when omitted the server's current date is used.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional; when present the owner's ageBand is derived from it against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the same last name and postcode (they share a household), and marks it as a declared member so it is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only; not stored.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: "/api/owners/1"
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the 'title' followed by a single space and the 'lastName' when a title is present, or just the 'lastName' when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: "DR who"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code derived from the postcode (falling back to the city, else UNKNOWN), FY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the registrationDate (fiscal year starting 1 July, identified by the calendar year in which it ends), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: "NSW261A2B3C4D7"
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household, derived deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256(normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode). Owners with the same last name and postcode always carry the same value automatically.
              type: string
              example: "5f2b3c1a-8d4e-3f6a-9b2c-1d0e7a5f4c33"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, starting at 0; add 2 when an email is present; add 1 when namesakeCount is 0; add 2 for a household of 3 or more (householdSize >= 3); add 3 for tenure of at least one elapsed fiscal year (the fiscal year of the registrationDate is earlier than the current fiscal year, fiscal years starting 1 July). A newly created owner has zero tenure.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints - 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3 points), 3 (4-5 points), 4 (6 or more points).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's locality (region), the REGION segment of the customerCode ('<REGION>-<HASH8>'), i.e. the region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city-to-region table Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when neither the postcode nor the city yields a region.
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region yields no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: "STANDARD_METRO"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's business day (a bulk sign-up), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not a hard duplicate, shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible (soft) duplicate of, set when possibleDuplicate is true, otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: True when the owner has been soft-deleted (marked deleted while the record is retained); false for a live owner. A newly created owner is false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The single derived key consolidating all duplicate detection, the SHA-256 hex digest (64 lower-case hex characters) of 'normalizedTelephone|email|soundex(lastName)' (email empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: "9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015a3bf4f1b2b0b822cd15d6c15b0f00a08"
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - the '+' and country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: "+61 412 345 678"
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: "ADULT"
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' (the last two digits of the fiscal year), where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the calendar year in which it ends (July-December belongs to the following year, January-June to that same year). Absent when no registrationDate is present.
              type: string
              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true

Added `fiscalYearOf(...)` and rewrote `regionOf(...)` to read the leading-letter region back out of the separator-free format.
